ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$, $AC$, $BD$ are the tangents to circle $\odot O$ with the points of tangency at $P$, $C$, and $D$, respectively. If $AB=5$ and $AC=3$, what is the length of $BD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB$, $AC$, and $BD$ are tangents to the circle $\odot O$,\\
it follows that AP=AC and BP=BD,\\
and since $AB=5$ and $AC=3$,\\
it follows that AP=3,\\
thus, BD=BP=AB-AP=\boxed{2}.
